purpose: Read-only prioritised projection of Defence Command Centre app rows plus bounded estate-level timeline-planning signals into human attention, blocked, safe machine action available, and healthy/no-action buckets.

buckets.meaning: The existing app next action explicitly requires human judgement, a pre-candidate human diff review is in progress/not started, or an estate-level timeline-planning action explicitly requires human review.
The current state has no authorised automatic path and requires repair, profile-claim refresh or investigation before workflow can continue.
An existing guarded helper is available and the next action does not require human judgement. The queue never executes it.
No current Defence action is required.

rules: Classification uses Command Centre fields only and never recomputes certification, deployment, review or timeline-planner validity.
Existing per-app items remain separate and preserve the exact app nextAction selected by Operations Controller.
Estate timeline-planning signals are emitted as separate scope=estate queue items and never overwrite an app workflow action.
unsupported_change always emits a human_attention estate item and is ordered before every app-level human-attention item.
Other timeline-planning states emit an estate item only when the Command Centre exposes an explicit human-required next action.
snapshot_hash_only and no_change do not create estate attention items.
Explicit app nextAction.humanRequired always maps to human_attention.
Pre-candidate review progress not_started or in_progress maps to human_attention.
blocked_canonical_state, profile_refresh_required, needs_review without an authorised helper, partial-service observation gaps and other no-helper remediation states map to blocked.
A non-human app next action with an existing helper maps to machine_action_available.
App nextAction none maps to healthy_no_action unless another explicit blocked/human condition applies.
items and counts remain app-only for backward-compatible estate accounting; estateItems contains estate-level signals; queueItems and queueCounts are the unified prioritised queue.
Unified ordering is deterministic: bucket, workflow-stage priority, estate before app for an equal stage, then stable id. unsupported_change has the earliest workflow-stage priority.
Priority is workflow ordering only, not a security risk score.
The attention queue is read-only and never invokes a helper or timeline append action.
nonClaims: Earlier queue position does not mean an app is less safe.
machine_action_available does not mean the action has been executed.
healthy_no_action does not imply perfect security.
An estate timeline signal does not change any app certification, review state, deployment state or next action.
unsupported_change does not mean the estate is unsafe; it means the current timeline-planning contract cannot safely classify new diff semantics without review.
